notes: translategemma serves its own chat template in-process; Qwen3 is the fallback. mic_device_index null = system default; stt_backend 'auto' runs speech-to-text on the GPU via mlx-audio when available (large-v3-turbo: 31x realtime on the GPU) and falls back to the CPU otherwise. llm_* enable an optional OpenAI-compatible rewrite endpoint; nothing is sent unless llm_enabled is true and a rewrite is invoked.
